disclaimer: Static pass — runtime verification pending. Focus traps, live regions, tab order, and var()-composited contrast cannot be verified from source alone. A green score is NOT WCAG certification.
detector_status: PARTIAL — Impeccable detector unavailable; findings from direct code reading and hand-computed WCAG contrast math

critical_findings.title: Incoming notifications are silent while any other view is active (live regions unmount)
critical_findings.fix: Always-mounted visually-hidden aria-live=polite region at App level rendering the latest notification message; surface unread count in the nav button aria-label

critical_findings.title: Health state transitions never announced; aria-label on role-less span is fragile
critical_findings.wcag: 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA); ARIA name-from-author on generic role
critical_findings.fix: Add role=status to the HealthDot outer span — legitimizes the aria-label and announces online/offline transitions politely

critical_findings.title: Online/offline state conveyed to sighted users by dot color alone
critical_findings.fix: Render visible state text beside the label (e.g. 'Systems · Offline') or differentiate shape (filled vs hollow ring), not just hue

critical_findings.title: Interactive control borders fail non-text contrast (1.19-1.36:1 vs required 3:1)
critical_findings.fix: Introduce --border-strong token (>= #7a7a7a) for select and button borders; keep --border for decorative card edges

critical_findings.title: Unread badge live announcement is the bare number; aria-label may not be spoken on change
critical_findings.fix: Add visually-hidden ' unread notifications' text inside the badge so the content change is self-describing; add .sr-only utility class

critical_findings.title: Brand h1 accessible name includes the lightning emoji, announced as 'high voltage'
critical_findings.fix: Wrap the emoji in a span with aria-hidden=true

critical_findings.title: Dashboard loading-to-count transitions and daemon-connected transition not announced
critical_findings.fix: role=status on the count paragraph; announce 'Connected' once when the daemon endpoint resolves

critical_findings.title: No forced-colors / prefers-contrast handling — state dots and borders flatten in Windows High Contrast
critical_findings.fix: Add @media (forced-colors: active) fallbacks with an outline/pattern differentiator for the state dots

recommendations.action: Always-mounted app-level aria-live=polite region announcing new notifications + unread count in the nav button label
role=status on HealthDot span (fixes 4.1.3 announcement + aria-label fragility in one attribute)
Visible state text or shape differentiation beside each health dot (1.4.1)
--border-strong token (>= #7a7a7a) for interactive control borders; update CSS contrast table
Visually-hidden text inside the unread badge + add .sr-only utility class
aria-hidden wrapper on the lightning emoji in the h1
forced-colors / prefers-contrast media blocks for dots and control borders
Runtime a11y pass in the shipped webview: axe scan, tab order, 200% zoom, VoiceOver/NVDA walkthrough of health flips and notification arrivals
Explicit type=button on the nav buttons (App.tsx:135) for form-safety consistency

roadmap_suggestions.title: SSE announcement bus (WCAG 4.1.3)
roadmap_suggestions.description: One always-mounted live region at App level narrating notification arrivals and health transitions, replacing per-view live regions that unmount on tab switch

roadmap_suggestions.title: Forced-colors and high-contrast mode support
roadmap_suggestions.description: Windows High Contrast flattens the state dots and borders; needs forced-colors media fallbacks plus visible state text

roadmap_suggestions.title: Runtime accessibility verification harness
roadmap_suggestions.description: Extend the vitest-axe gate with a WebDriver-driven pass in the real Tauri webview covering tab order, 200% zoom, and live-region announcements
